plugin.name: snap-keys
plugin._long: Arrow keys that put the window in front on a half, a quarter or the whole of the screen, each press going on from where the window is.

option.name: left
option._long: Moves the window towards the left: onto the left half, from an upper or lower half onto its left quarter, from the right half back to where it was.

option.name: right
option._long: Moves the window towards the right: onto the right half, from an upper or lower half onto its right quarter, from the left half back to where it was.

option.name: up
option._long: Moves the window up: a floating window fills the screen, a half becomes its upper quarter, a lower quarter becomes its half.

option.name: down
option._long: Moves the window down: the whole screen goes back to where the window was, a floating window is put away into the dock, a half becomes its lower quarter.
